website_summary.name: Social Media Profile Viewer
website_summary.description: The website presents a sleek, dark-themed interface showcasing Elon Musk's social media profile with posts, follower statistics, and interactive elements.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a clean and modern design with a dark background and white text, enhancing readability. At the top, there's a navigation bar with a back arrow and the title "Elon Musk." Below this, the main profile section displays Elon Musk's avatar, name, handle (@elonmusk), and a brief description mentioning his affiliations with SpaceX, Tesla, Boring Company, X Corp, and Neuralink. The profile also shows follower and following counts. Below the profile details, there are tabs labeled "Posts," "Replies," "Highlights," "Media," and "Likes," allowing users to navigate through different types of content. The posts are displayed in a list format, each with a timestamp, content, engagement metrics (likes, retweets, comments), and interactive icons.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to view and interact with Elon Musk's social media content. Users can browse through various types of posts by clicking on the respective tabs. Each post includes options to like, comment, retweet, and share. Additionally, users can follow Elon Musk by clicking the "Follow" button. The website also provides a way to subscribe to notifications related to the profile. The engagement metrics for each post are dynamically updated, reflecting real-time interactions.
